given_when_then.given: The Order Allocation Engine receives an Order Request with items available at multiple Store Partners
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine calculates the distance between the customer location and all eligible Store Partners
given_when_then.then: The system identifies the nearest Store Partner based on the shortest estimated preparation and dispatch time

given_when_then.given: A customer places an Order Request with items available at multiple Store Partners
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
given_when_then.then: The system assigns the order to the nearest Store Partner with sufficient stock and creates a Fulfillment Task

given_when_then.given: A customer places an Order Request where no Store Partner has sufficient stock for all items
given_when_then.when: The Order Allocation Engine processes the request
given_when_then.then: The system does not assign the order and flags it for manual review without creating a Fulfillment Task

success_criteria: The system assigns the order to the nearest Store Partner with sufficient stock and creates a Fulfillment Task
The system does not assign the order and flags it for manual review without creating a Fulfillment Task
The Real-Time Inventory Snapshot is updated immediately after automatic assignment to prevent overselling
